Litter box selection is limited and prices not properly posted.

I am extremely disappointed with the drastic price difference between the Petco website and the Petco Union Square Flagship Store. When booking online, the price for dog grooming was listed at $88 per dog, but when I dropped off my dogs, I was told the starting price was $128 per dog. I have never experienced anything like this, and NO, the price difference was not disclosed or reflected on the website.
While my groomer was courteous and did a good job grooming my dogs, the service itself was nothing extraordinary. I requested a simple shave and face trim, with no special cut or styling. I also did not request any additional services or add-ons.
I called to speak with a manager about the pricing discrepancy. He apologized for cutting me off mid-sentence, explaining that he was the only manager working at the time for the entire store. He took my phone number and assured me he would call me back, but that call never came. I ultimately paid $280 for grooming two dogs, which is simply outrageous for the basic service I received, especially when I had not requested any extras.
Unfortunately, the customer service experience was just as disappointing. Some employees were courteous, while others came across as rude and dismissive. The manager, in particular, could benefit from additional training in customer service and communication.
If Petco is going to charge premium prices at its Union Square Flagship Store, it needs to operate at that level. That means being transparent about pricing, properly managing the store, and ensuring employees are trained to deliver the level of professionalism and customer service customers expect when paying premium prices.
